Author line = first & senior author; the corresponding author is named where PubMed lists an electronic address, otherwise the first author's institution is given. Window used: publication dates 2020-09-01 → 2022-09-01, deduplicated against every prior digest, episode script and outreach log in this track. Long-Term Functional Outcomes After Volar Capsulodesis for Treatment of Scapholunate Ligament Injuries: An 18-Year Experience Aida K Sarcon & Steven L Moran — Mayo Clinic, Rochester, MN, USA Single-institution observational series (2004–2022; 28 patients, mean follow-up 86 months) of volar scapholunate capsulodesis using a strip of the long radiolunate ligament for injuries with a torn volar SL component; mean DASH was 16.4 and PRWE 24.6, grip reached 79% of the contralateral side, 79% returned to prior work, and only two patients required secondary surgery.
